scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cds.title: University of Illinois Chicago Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set 2025-26 (fall 2025 first-year class): 29,929 applied (12,719 men, 17,210 women), 22,674 admitted, 5,405 enrolled. The residency rows (in-state, out-of-state, international) were left blank in C1, so those counts are not available; the CDS B2 table shows 256 nonresident (international) degree-seeking first-time first-years enrolled. The CDS answers No to having a waiting list; early decision is not offered and early action (Nov. 1 in the CDS, Nov. 2 this cycle) is non-binding. SAT submitted by 47% (2,518 students) and ACT by 4% (226). The GPA ranges are the 'all enrolled students' column of C11 (0.04% were below 1.0 and are left out). Undergraduate enrollment (24,260) and the nonresident count (1,825) are the 'Total Undergraduates (both degree- and non-degree-seeking)' figures (B1/B2); degree-seeking nonresidents were 1,696.

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set (G1 is labelled 'FULL 2026-2027 academic year'): in-state tuition $11,652, out-of-state and nonresident tuition $28,352, required fees $3,294, on-campus food and housing $17,100. The CDS says tuition varies by program (67.7% of full-time undergraduates pay more than the base figure shown), so engineering, business, nursing and other differential programs cost more. Estimated expenses: books $1,400, transportation $1,526, other $4,500 (other costs shown = transportation + other). Per-credit-hour: $427 in-state, $899 out-of-state, $922 international (part-time). From the CDS (H6): 173 nonresident undergraduates received institutional non-need-based aid, average $3,918.
